name: Storage Zone
description: A named area of the store (a bank of numbered slots, a display case, a rack, a safe). Its positions are the Storage Locations. Managed from the Storage Locations page.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Slots = numbered slots that each hold exactly one firearm. Open = one location with no limit that holds firearms and everything else (create one zone per rack, case or safe).

fields.label: Positions
fields.description: How many positions the zone has had created. Positions are only ever added, never removed.

fields.label: Sides
fields.description: How many sides (lines of slots) a Slots zone has on the map: a two-sided rack is 2. 0 = fit them to the shape it is drawn as. A plan shape's own Lines of slots wins over this.

fields.label: Numbering
fields.description: How a two-sided Slots zone's numbers run on the map. Odd / even: 1, 3, 5 … down one side and 2, 4, 6 … facing them. In order: 1, 2, 3 … down the first side, then the second. One side or three and more always count in order.
